name: Ferdinand II
summary: Habsburg ruler and Holy Roman Emperor whose goals included dynastic security, Catholic restoration, and stronger imperial authority.

name: Maximilian I of Bavaria
summary: Duke of Bavaria and leading Catholic League power whose military support was crucial but increased Bavarian leverage over imperial policy.

name: Frederick V of the Palatinate
summary: Elector Palatine who accepted the Bohemian crown, turning a Bohemian crisis into an imperial and international problem.

name: John George I of Saxony
summary: Elector of Saxony whose Lutheran, legalist, and territorial interests made him a pivotal but wary imperial partner.

name: Spanish Habsburg representative
summary: A placeholder for Spanish Habsburg diplomatic and military interests, especially the Rhine corridor and Dutch war context.

name: Bohemian estate leader
summary: A composite for the Bohemian estate opposition defending religious privileges and estate liberties against Habsburg authority.
